data.name: Intro

data.comment: Line under the heading of the Tidy up page.

data.name: Nothing
data.comment: Shown on the Tidy up page when no section has anything in it.

data.comment: Heading of a section on the Tidy up page.

data.comment: Heading of a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: SectionParentMissing

data.name: SectionSame

data.comment: Heading of a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: SectionTags
data.comment: Heading of a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: SectionProducts
data.comment: Heading of a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: SectionMixes
data.comment: Heading of a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: HintOpen
data.value: Tap one to open it and fix it there.
data.comment: Line under a section on the Tidy up page whose lines open a plant.

data.name: HintParentMissing
data.value: The plant they were taken from was removed. Open the cutting to pick another parent, or none.
data.comment: Line under a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: HintSame
data.value: Two plants in the same room with the same name. If they are different plants, say so and they stop showing.
data.comment: Line under a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: HintTags
data.value: No plant in your collection has these. They are only left on plants that are gone.
data.comment: Line under a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: HintProducts
data.value: No care entry, feed or stock points at these.
data.comment: Line under a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: HintMixes
data.value: No plant or cutting is in these.
data.comment: Line under a section on the Tidy up page.

data.name: And
data.comment: Between the names of two plants that may be the same, as in 'Basil and Basil'.

data.name: InRoom
data.comment: After two plants that may be the same. {0} is the room they are in.

data.name: NotTheSame
data.comment: Button on a pair of plants that may be the same. They stop showing in the list.

data.name: NotTheSameFor
data.value: {0} and {1} are not the same plant
data.comment: Name read out for the Not the same button. {0} and {1} are plant names.

data.name: NotTheSameDone
data.value: {0} and {1} won't show as the same again.
data.comment: Shown after Not the same was tapped. {0} and {1} are plant names.

data.name: RemoveNamed
data.comment: Name read out for a Remove button. {0} is a tag, product or soil mix.

data.name: ConfirmRemove
data.comment: Asked before an unused tag, product or soil mix is removed. {0} is its name.

data.name: ConfirmYes
data.comment: Button that removes it after the question.

data.name: Removed
data.comment: Shown after removing. {0} is the name.

data.name: StillUsed
data.value: {0} is used after all, so it stays.
data.comment: Shown when something was used again before it could be removed. {0} is the name.

data.name: Error
data.comment: Shown on the Tidy up page when a change fails. {0} is the reason.

data.name: ShowAll
data.comment: Button under a long section on the Tidy up page. {0} is how many there are.

data.name: ShowFewer
data.comment: Button that folds a long section back up.

data.name: MentionChoices
data.value: Plants, propagations and pots to link
data.comment: Name of the list that opens when typing @ in a note, read out by a screen reader.

data.name: MentionKindPlant
data.comment: Small word after a plant in the list that opens when typing @ in a note.

data.name: MentionKindPropagation
data.comment: Small word after a propagation in the list that opens when typing @ in a note.

data.name: MentionKindPot
data.comment: Small word after a pot in the list that opens when typing @ in a note.

data.name: MentionedInHeading
data.comment: Heading of the card on a plant or propagation that lists the notes that mention it.

data.name: MentionedInCase
data.comment: Name of a pest case update in the Mentioned in card. {0} is the pest.

data.name: ParentIsGuess
data.comment: Checkbox on the edit form, shown once a parent is picked. Ticked when the parent isn't certain.

data.name: ProbablyFromPlant
data.comment: On a plant's page in place of 'from {0}' when the parent is a guess. {0} is the parent, {1} a note like 'lives with Anna' or empty.

data.name: ProbablyFromParent
data.comment: On a propagation's page in place of 'from {0}' when the parent plant is a guess. {0} is the parent.

data.name: ImportKindLabel
data.comment: Name of the choice at the start of the spreadsheet import, read out by a screen reader.

data.name: ImportKindPlants
data.comment: Choice at the start of the spreadsheet import: plants.

data.name: ImportKindPropagations
data.comment: Choice at the start of the spreadsheet import: propagations.

data.name: ImportPropsPageTitle
data.comment: Title of the browser tab on the page that imports propagations from a spreadsheet.

data.name: ImportPropsTitle
data.comment: Heading of the page that imports propagations from a spreadsheet.

data.name: ImportPropsIntro
data.value: Bring in propagations from Excel, Google Sheets or a list you keep somewhere else. Save the sheet as CSV and choose the file, or copy the cells, headings included, and paste them. A column with the plant each one was taken from links it to that plant.
data.comment: Introduction on the first step of the page that imports propagations from a spreadsheet.

data.name: ImportPropagationsLabel
data.comment: Heading and name of the step that lists the propagations found in the file.

data.name: ImportPropagation_One
data.comment: Count of propagations in the button to check them. {0} is 1.

data.name: ImportPropagation_Other
data.comment: Count of propagations in the button to check them. {0} is the number, not 1.

data.name: ImportNextCheck
data.comment: Button that goes on to the propagations. {0} is a count like '3 propagations'.

data.name: ImportNoRows
data.value: There are no propagations to import.
data.comment: Shown when the file has no rows.

data.name: ImportNoRowsInFile
data.value: There are no propagations in that file.
data.comment: Shown after choosing a file with no rows.

data.name: ImportNoRowsPasted
data.value: There are no propagations in what you pasted.
data.comment: Shown after pasting cells with no rows.

data.name: ImportParentIs
data.comment: On a row of the import: the plant its parent column matched. {0} is the plant.

data.name: ImportParentNotFound
data.comment: On a row of the import and in the result: no plant has the name in the parent column, so the parent is left empty. {0} is the name from the file.

data.name: ImportParentSeveral
data.comment: On a row of the import and in the result: more than one plant has the name in the parent column, so the parent is left empty. {0} is the name from the file.

data.name: ImportNoParentCount
data.comment: In the line of counts above the rows of the import. {0} is how many rows have no parent because it wasn't found or was unclear.

data.name: ImportNoParent
data.comment: Heading in the result of the import over the rows whose parent plant wasn't found or was unclear.

data.name: ImportCount
data.comment: On a row of the import. {0} is how many cuttings the row starts with.

data.name: ImportAdd_One
data.comment: Button that adds the ticked propagation. {0} is 1.

data.name: ImportAdd_Other
data.comment: Button that adds the ticked propagations. {0} is the number, not 1.

data.name: ImportAdded_One
data.comment: Heading of the result of the import. {0} is 1.

data.name: ImportAdded_Other
data.comment: Heading of the result of the import. {0} is the number, not 1.

data.name: ImportNoneAdded
data.comment: Heading of the result of the import when nothing was added.

data.name: ImportUndone_One
data.comment: Shown after Undo on the result of the import. {0} is 1, so it isn't in the text.

data.name: ImportUndone_Other
data.comment: Shown after Undo on the result of the import. {0} is the number, not 1.

data.name: ImportGoToPropagations
data.comment: Button on the result of the import that opens the list of propagations.

data.name: ImportAddFailedNone
data.value: Couldn't add the propagations on this device. Nothing was added, so you can try again.
data.comment: Shown when the import of propagations failed before anything was added.
